name: Your agent finds a product and adds it to your cart
description: The demo agent calls the page's real tools in order and the item lands in the shopper's own cart, marked as the agent's.

planSteps.description: Open the home page of this site
Click the 'Your agent' button at the bottom right of the page
Verify a panel headed 'Your agent' lists the tools search_catalog, get_product, add_to_cart, remove_from_cart and view_cart
Verify the panel states 'No payment tool. Paying stays with you.'
Under 'Give the demo agent a task', click 'Find the Air Jordan 5 in size 9 and add it' and wait for the agent's reply
Verify 'Tool calls' shows, in this order, search_catalog, get_product, add_to_cart and view_cart
Verify the reply reads 'Added Air Jordan 5 Retro Mens Shoes, size 9. Your cart total is $225.75.'
Verify the header cart button shows 1
Verify the line 'Air Jordan 5 Retro Mens Shoes' shows 'Option: 9', is marked 'Added by your agent', and the Total reads '$225.75'
